# gcore_cloud_gpu_virtual_cluster_volumes (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gcore_cloud_gpu_virtual_cluster_volumes" "example_cloud_gpu_virtual_cluster_volumes" {
  project_id = 1
  region_id = 7
  cluster_id = "1aaaab48-10d0-46d9-80cc-85209284ceb4"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster unique identifier

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Max items to fetch, default: 1000
- `project_id` (Number) Project ID
- `region_id` (Number) Region ID

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The items returned by the data source (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `bootable` (Boolean) True if this is bootable volume
- `created_at` (String) Volume creation date and time
- `id` (String) Volume unique identifier
- `name` (String) User defined name
- `root_fs` (Boolean) True if this volume contains root file system
- `server_id` (String) Server UUID
- `size` (Number) Volume size in GiB
- `status` (String) Current volume status
Available values: "attaching", "available", "awaiting-transfer", "backing-up", "creating", "deleting", "detaching", "downloading", "error", "error_backing-up", "error_deleting", "error_extending", "error_restoring", "extending", "in-use", "maintenance", "reserved", "restoring-backup", "retyping", "reverting", "uploading".
- `tags` (Attributes List) User defined tags (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--tags))
- `type` (String) Volume type

<a id="nestedatt--items--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) Tag key. Maximum 255 characters. Cannot contain spaces, tabs, newlines, empty string or '=' character.
- `read_only` (Boolean) If true, the tag is read-only and cannot be modified by the user
- `value` (String) Tag value. Maximum 255 characters. Cannot contain spaces, tabs, newlines, empty string or '=' character.
